name: generate_avatar_video
description: Create a short talking-avatar video with HeyGen Avatar IV. Supply an exact script (maximum 75 words and 1000 characters) plus voice_id, OR existing audio of at most 30 seconds. Supply a discovered avatar LOOK ID, OR a source image. Images/audio accept Stash references, permitted local paths or HTTPS URLs. This makes a paid video; it does not train avatars or clone voices. Use heygen list_avatars/list_voices for exact IDs. Saves the completed MP4 to Stash. If a response includes provider_video_id, kind and receipt_stash_ref, use heygen status/collect for that same job; never submit another video to poll or recover it. After Web background admission wait for automatic delivery; Jarvis background job_id is not the provider_video_id.

script.description: Exact words to speak, preserved verbatim. Maximum 75 words; about a 30-second cost-bounded first release. Requires voice_id. Omit with audio_source.

audio_source.description: Existing WAV/MP3 audio, at most 30 seconds: stash:// reference, permitted local path or public HTTPS URL. Alternative to script/voice_id.

avatar_id.description: Exact ready avatar LOOK ID from heygen action=list_avatars; do not use an avatar group ID. Alternative to image_source.

image_source.description: A source portrait: stash:// reference, permitted local path or public HTTPS URL. Alternative to avatar_id. The source image is uploaded to HeyGen.

voice_id.description: Exact voice ID from heygen action=list_voices. Required with script; omit with audio_source.

availability.setup_hint: Set HEYGEN_API_KEY in the selected mode to enable optional paid HeyGen generation.
